Ears count as two separate flap leaves per the folded-flap rule. Neck/head/trunk segmentation and leg joint splits (shoulder/knee/foot, hip/knee/foot) are anatomical inferences from the single continuous limb silhouettes in the XY panel; the ZY and XZ panels were used only to set left/right (z) offsets for ears and the four legs, keeping all four legs equal in proportion despite the walking-stride pose shown in the XY panel (front legs at slightly different x due to gait phase, not true length difference). Ground line at grid y=20 in the XY panel confirms all four feet reach the same height, used to keep leg lengths consistent.
